faq.domanda: What are the advantages of DTF printing for clothing?
faq.risposta: The DTF (Direct to Film) technique transfers high-resolution images directly onto the fabric, with vivid colours and excellent durability. It's ideal for t-shirts, hoodies and promotional items that need to still look great after many washes, like those worn every day in the workshop or on the job.

It involves applying heat-transfer films directly onto the item. It's a versatile and affordable solution, perfect for logos, names and simple graphics or for numbering a team's shirts. Durable and suited to many types of fabric.

faq.domanda: When is embroidery the right choice for custom clothing?
faq.risposta: Embroidery is elegant and very long-lasting, ideal for company uniforms, polos, softshells and caps. It works well on heavier fabrics and gives a professional look that enhances your brand in more formal settings, from welcoming clients to events.

faq.domanda: How much does it cost to personalise clothing for a Biasca business?
faq.risposta: The price depends on the technique you choose (DTF, heat transfers or embroidery), the complexity of the graphics and the number of items: the more items you order, the lower the unit cost. For a tradesperson or a small business, we prepare a tailored quote, free and with no obligation.

faq.domanda: How long does an order take in Biasca and across Ticino?
faq.risposta: Small orders usually take a couple of working days, while larger volumes or complex graphics take a little longer. Working in Ticino keeps us close by, and we give you a precise delivery date right in the quote, wherever you are.

We personalise t-shirts, polos, hoodies, softshell and work jackets, gilets, caps and technical clothing. Every item is worked with the technique best suited to the fabric and its use, from the building site to events and the shop.

faq.domanda: Do you personalise small quantities for small businesses too?
faq.risposta: Yes. We're happy to work with tradespeople, shops and families who want just a few pieces or a single item. No order is too small: our personalisation is designed for anyone with a compact business who still cares about their image.

faq.domanda: Which techniques hold up best to washing?
faq.risposta: Embroidery is the most resistant and long-lasting technique, perfect for items washed often like work uniforms. DTF printing also offers excellent durability over time, as long as the item is washed following the instructions: both hold up well to daily use.
